title:en: Digital agriculture is concentrating corporate power over food systems
description:en: Short IPES-Food article on how digitalisation is driving corporate concentration in food systems, and the source of the power-concentration graphic (Big Ag and Big Tech mergers and partnerships) used in Module 1.

title:en: Head in the Cloud: challenging the false promise of digital agriculture and cultivating innovation from the ground up
description:en: IPES-Food report (February 2026) arguing that corporate-led digital agriculture — AI, data platforms and automation — deepens farmer dependency and concentrates control over data and decisions, and making the case for bottom-up agroecological innovation grounded in local knowledge and collective learning.

title:en: Big Brother is Coming to the Farm: the digital takeover of food
description:en: Short animated film by ETC Group (with Freehand Studio) on how large corporations are reshaping agriculture and food through digital technologies, and why food sovereignty and agroecology offer an alternative. The English version is embedded here; the playlist link has the same film in Spanish, French, Arabic, Bahasa Indonesia, Filipino, Hindi, Italian, Portuguese, Kiswahili and more.

title:en: Digital Power: State of Power 2023
description:en: The Transnational Institute's annual State of Power report, 2023 edition, on digital power: who holds it, how it is exercised and how it can be contested. Long-form background reading — a full book rather than a single article.

title:en: Digitalization and Land Governance
description:en: FIAN International research paper on how the digitalisation of land records and land administration affects land tenure, and the lock-ins and dependencies it can create for rural communities.

title:en: Digitalization, AI and Data Governance in Food Systems and Beyond (CSIPM webinar)
description:en: Recording of a Civil Society and Indigenous Peoples' Mechanism (CSIPM) webinar on digitalisation, AI and data governance in food systems. A long-form recording made up of several presentations; the first presentation accompanies IPES-Food's Head in the Cloud report.

title:en: Impacts on people's territories and self-determined use of technologies (CSIPM webinar)
description:en: Recording of a Civil Society and Indigenous Peoples' Mechanism (CSIPM) webinar on the impacts of digitalisation on peoples' territories and on the self-determined use of technologies. A long-form recording made up of several presentations.

title:en: Data privacy alone is not enough when farmers' land, seeds and lives are at stake
description:en: Matt Canfield (AFSA video) argues that the data-privacy frame misses what is really at stake for farmers — land, seeds and collective life — and that non-personal and collective data need their own protections.

title:en: AI's Large Looting Models: the emerging generative biology stack as the next frontier of biopiracy
description:en: IT for Change paper on how generative AI applied to biology (the 'generative biology stack') extends corporate control over genetic resources and traditional knowledge, framed as a new frontier of biopiracy.

title:en: AI & Data Sovereignty: emerging technologies and Indigenous governance
description:en: GroundWork video on artificial intelligence, data sovereignty and Indigenous governance of emerging technologies.

title:en: IARAA: artificial intelligence at the service of the peasantry and food sovereignty in Brazil
description:en: Article from Defending Peasants' Rights on IARAA, a Brazilian initiative putting artificial intelligence at the service of peasant movements and food sovereignty — a constructive counter-example to corporate AI in agriculture.

title:en: What does data justice mean for African small-holder farmers? Towards a human rights-based approach in Africa
description:en: Agroecology Now article by Sabrina Masinjila, Barbara and Matt Canfield on what data justice means for African smallholder farmers: data as embedded in relationships with territories, communities and governments rather than an individual resource, and the case for a human rights-based approach.

title:en: Recovering the 'public' in India's Digital Public Infrastructure
description:en: IT for Change paper on India's digital public infrastructure (DPI) and what it would take to recover a genuinely public character for it — data governance, accountability and public value rather than private capture.

title:en: Rethinking data governance for truly public DPI
description:en: Research ICT Africa article (August 2025) on rethinking data governance so that digital public infrastructure serves the public interest.

title:en: Stop Data Colonialism campaign
description:en: Honor the Earth's campaign page on data colonialism: how data extraction and digital infrastructure (including data centres) affect Indigenous peoples and their lands, and how to resist it.

title:en: Farm Tech Market Map: why it's time to distinguish farm tech from the messy supply chain
description:en: The Mixing Bowl's market map of farm technology companies and an argument for separating on-farm technology from the wider agri-food supply chain when analysing the sector. A useful picture of who the players are.

title:en: New but for whom? Discourses of innovation in precision agriculture
description:en: Peer-reviewed article in Agriculture and Human Values (2021) examining how 'innovation' is framed in precision agriculture and whose interests those discourses serve. Paywalled; check for an open-access copy.

title:en: Peasants' Rights Explained: an illustrated version of UNDROP
description:en: La Via Campesina's illustrated explanation of the UN Declaration on the Rights of Peasants and Other People Working in Rural Areas (UNDROP) — the rights framework behind a rights-based approach to digitalisation.

title:en: Gathering for Open Agricultural Technology (GOAT)
description:en: GOAT is a community of farmers, technologists and researchers building and sharing open-source agricultural technology. Website with events, projects and resources.

title:en: Introduction to Agricultural Informatics (open course)
description:en: Open course materials from the Agricultural Informatics Lab at Purdue University introducing agricultural informatics: data, sensors, software and decision tools in agriculture.

title:en: Farmer Perspectives on Data
description:en: Research report by Slattery et al. for Trust in Food and The Sustainability Consortium on how farmers in the United States view agricultural data: who should own it, who they trust with it and what they want in return.

title:en: Small Farms and the Future of AgTech: a needs assessment in California's San Joaquin Valley
description:en: Community Alliance with Family Farmers (CAFF) needs assessment (Siemens, Vaughan and Ridoutt-Orozco, 2025) of what small farms in California's San Joaquin Valley actually need from agricultural technology.

title:en: Principles for inclusion of smallholders in digital tools
description:en: CGIAR report (Dittmer et al., 2024) setting out principles for including smallholder farmers in the design and governance of digital agricultural tools.

title:en: opengrains
description:en: opengrains.cc — an open resource on grain and seed systems, referenced from IT for Change (2022) and GRAIN (2021) material used in Module 1.
